why_ai: AI matching absorbs database search, but employer-of-record duties and client relationships keep the agency.
why_clarity: A filled requisition is clear, though whether the placement sticks shows weeks later.
why_digital: Resumes and job orders are digital, but the delivered product is a worker on site.

why_ai: FCRA-regulated reporting needs accountable compliance and some courthouse retrieval; verification is otherwise routine.
why_clarity: Each record search and verification returns a defined result against an adjudication matrix.
why_digital: Court and employer records retrieved, compiled and delivered as digital reports nationwide.

why_ai: Billing, burden and margin follow deterministic rules that automate fully once inputs are clean.
why_clarity: SUTA, overtime and burden rules give exact, reconcilable answers every pay week.
why_digital: Time records in, payroll and invoices out, all in back-office software.

why_ai: Semantic matching over placement history is a well-defined ML task replacing keyword search.
why_clarity: Matches recur at volume, but placement success labels arrive only after the start.
why_digital: Resumes and job orders matched and ranked inside the ATS.

why_ai: Confidential employer pay submissions are a data moat AI cannot generate.
why_clarity: Annual surveys match jobs to a maintained architecture with a fixed method.
why_digital: Pay data collected and benchmarks published entirely online.

why_ai: Programme governance and supplier relationships persist, though rate benchmarking and scoring are automatable.
why_clarity: Fill rates, cycle times and rate compliance are tracked per requisition.
why_digital: Requisitions, rates and scorecards run through vendor management systems.

why_ai: Workers show up at a dispatch hall for physical jobs, though gig apps threaten the dispatcher.
why_clarity: Bodies on site by the start time is a clear daily pass or fail.
why_digital: Paper sign-ins, phone calls and cash pay for in-person job sites.

why_ai: Licence verification is accountable and travel placement relies on recruiter-clinician relationships.
why_clarity: Every clinician needs a checkable credential packet before a defined start date.
why_digital: Credentials handled digitally across states; the delivered service is a clinician at a facility.

why_ai: Per-form penalties and audit defence need accountable specialists, though form processing is automatable.
why_clarity: I-9 rules define exact requirements per form, though audit outcomes arrive later.
why_digital: Identity documents and forms processed electronically, with audits answered in writing.

why_ai: National-scale matching and pricing models are AI-native work on platform-owned data.
why_clarity: Applications and hires give fast, measurable feedback on ranking models.
why_digital: Postings, profiles and models run entirely on online platforms.

why_ai: LLMs parse postings and build skills taxonomies, eroding the curation moat.
why_clarity: Taxonomy correctness is a matter of curatorial judgement, though posting counts are objective.
why_digital: Scraped postings in, taxonomies and analytics out, sold online.

why_ai: Branches dispatch hundreds of workers daily as employer of record; scheduling itself is automatable.
why_clarity: Fifteen workers on site by 7 AM is an instant, objective test.
why_digital: Phone and text dispatch from local branches, delivering bodies to warehouse sites.

why_ai: Credit decisions on client debtors are data-driven, with capital provision the durable part.
why_clarity: Advances are repaid or diluted on a weekly cycle with clear outcomes.
why_digital: Invoices, credit data and funding move electronically.

why_ai: Placement depends on community trust, language and in-person case support around complex work authorisation.
why_clarity: Each case combines unique documents, foreign credentials and personal barriers.
why_digital: Paper files and face-to-face relationships through resettlement organisations.

why_ai: Human support and employer trust are what make second-chance placements stick.
why_clarity: Each person's record and barriers differ, and retention is known months later.
why_digital: Case management and placement happen in person through reentry programmes.

why_ai: Certification matching is structured and automatable, while demand for trades labour keeps the agency busy.
why_clarity: Certifications like AWS D1.1 and OSHA 30 make fit checkable against the job order.
why_digital: Certs and skill tests feed placement of workers delivered to physical job sites.

why_ai: Member data and advocacy standing persist, but compiling statistics is routine.
why_clarity: Quarterly statistics follow a repeatable method on member submissions.
why_digital: Member submissions in, digital statistics and analyses out.

why_ai: Decades of confidential rate submissions are a moat, though analysis and writing are automatable.
why_clarity: Benchmarks are repeatable, but market sizing and forecasts cannot be checked quickly.
why_digital: Confidential submissions in, digital research and benchmarks out.

why_ai: Branch, desk and margin reporting is internal analytics AI tools perform.
why_clarity: Margins and productivity reconcile weekly against billing records.
why_digital: Placement and billing data analysed internally on screen.

why_ai: Fill-rate and redeployment analytics inside ATS platforms are product features AI builds.
why_clarity: Fills, tenure and redeployment are recorded outcomes across thousands of agencies.
why_digital: Platform records analysed and delivered as software features and reports.

why_ai: Insurers carry catastrophic risk on unseen workers at uncontrolled sites, needing accountable underwriting judgement.
why_clarity: Losses develop over years, so pricing and class decisions are confirmed slowly.
why_digital: Payroll and claims data underwritten on screen, with some client site inspections.

why_ai: Protests follow statutory forms and separation facts that automation handles; hearings need representatives.
why_clarity: Each claim gets a determination, and appeal outcomes are recorded.
why_digital: Claims filed and protested through fifty state online systems and phone hearings.

why_ai: Employment lawyers apply multi-factor tests case by case under privilege and carry the liability.
why_clarity: Tests differ by agency and state, and determinations are tested only in audits or litigation.
why_digital: Contracts and facts reviewed on screen, with advice under attorney-client relationships.
